describe: The image shows a tall, narrow fire with a dark grey smoke plume. The flames are concentrated in the lower-middle of the frame, bright orange and yellow with hot streaks. Grey smoke rises above and curls to the left, with a separate faint orange-tinted smoke wisp near the top. Contrast is moderate to high in the flames. The surrounding mid-grey is probably a transparent area shown on grey, so the fire and smoke are the only objects.
